subject.title: Algorithms, by Jeff Erickson
subject.overview: Based on Algorithms by Jeff Erickson (CC BY 4.0), free at https://jeffe.cs.illinois.edu/teaching/algorithms/
subject.brief: First-year university students taking this as part of a course, often studying alone on a phone between classes. Comfortable with high-school maths; new to the subject's vocabulary. Short readings, plenty of checks, and help that explains a wrong answer without talking down.

title: Recursion
overview: Covers Reductions; Simplify and Delegate; Tower of Hanoi; Mergesort; Quicksort; The Pattern; Recursion Trees; Linear-Time Selection; Fast Multiplication; Exponentiation.
